( #{transaction.sourceApi}, #{transaction.sourceUniqueKey}, #{transaction.propertyCategory}, #{transaction.tradeType}, #{transaction.sggCode}, #{transaction.sourceDealYm}, #{transaction.legalDongCode}, #{transaction.umdName}, #{transaction.jibun}, #{transaction.buildingName}, #{transaction.sourceBuildingCode}, #{transaction.buildingDong}, #{transaction.houseType}, #{transaction.exclusiveAreaM2}, #{transaction.totalFloorAreaM2}, #{transaction.landAreaM2}, #{transaction.floor}, #{transaction.buildYear}, #{transaction.dealDate}, #{transaction.dealAmount}, #{transaction.deposit}, #{transaction.monthlyRent}, #{transaction.convertedPrice}, #{transaction.canceled}, #{transaction.cancellationDate}, NOW(), NOW() )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE property_category = VALUES(property_category), trade_type = VALUES(trade_type), sgg_code = VALUES(sgg_code), source_deal_ym = VALUES(source_deal_ym), legal_dong_code = VALUES(legal_dong_code), umd_name = VALUES(umd_name), jibun = VALUES(jibun), building_name = VALUES(building_name), source_building_code = VALUES(source_building_code), building_dong = VALUES(building_dong), house_type = VALUES(house_type), exclusive_area_m2 = VALUES(exclusive_area_m2), total_floor_area_m2 = VALUES(total_floor_area_m2), land_area_m2 = VALUES(land_area_m2), floor = VALUES(floor), build_year = VALUES(build_year), deal_date = VALUES(deal_date), deal_amount = VALUES(deal_amount), deposit = VALUES(deposit), monthly_rent = VALUES(monthly_rent), converted_price = VALUES(converted_price), canceled = VALUES(canceled), cancellation_date = VALUES(cancellation_date), updated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO market_transaction_sync ( source_api, sgg_code, deal_ym, last_attempt_status, total_count, last_success_at, last_attempt_at, last_error ) VALUES ( #{sourceApi}, #{sggCode}, #{dealYm}, 'SUCCESS', #{totalCount}, NOW(), NOW(), NULL ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_attempt_status = 'SUCCESS', total_count = VALUES(total_count), last_success_at = NOW(), last_attempt_at = NOW(), last_error = NULL

INSERT INTO market_transaction_sync ( source_api, sgg_code, deal_ym, last_attempt_status, total_count, last_success_at, last_attempt_at, last_error ) VALUES ( #{sourceApi}, #{sggCode}, #{dealYm}, 'FAILED', 0, NULL, NOW(), LEFT(#{lastError}, 500) ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_attempt_status = 'FAILED', last_attempt_at = NOW(), last_error = LEFT(VALUES(last_error), 500)
